summary: F-09 implemented. Photo-build report.json now has `caption_fallback_steps`: the step IDs whose caption came back None, and `[]` when vision is disabled. `template_fallback_steps` and `empty_metadata_steps` stay `[]`, and `build_sidecar_report` is untouched. The session page and review page both render a "Caption-fallback steps" section, and `_color_for` colours it red like template fallback. I added the three named tests (the vision-disabled one patches `load_models_config` instead of editing a temp config file). `ruff check` and `ruff format` are clean. The full `pytest` run gave 555 passed and 5 skipped, with all of `test_frozen_paths.py` (10 tests) deselected instead of run. I did not commit.
